sentences.text:
Statutory auditors of Uflex were Ernst and Young, BDO India LLP and KAAP &
Associates, who are reputed firms.

In fact, the statutory auditors in their annual audit reports have time and again stated that according to the information and explanations given to them, no material fraud on the company by its officers or employees has been noticed or reported during the course of their audit.

g. TDS was deducted against each of those invoices and was duly deposited before the concerned authorities and, furthermore, Uflex has also admittedly availed GST benefits against all the allegedly false invoices.
h. As per the IO's Status Report, Uflex runs completely on software called Oracle.
Therefore, it is impossible that the software would not have flagged anomalies if the payments were released in contravention/deviation from the SOP.
However, neither the Complainant has furnished the Oracle data, nor the IO has ever sought or investigated this aspect of the case.

The present application under Section 528 of the BNSS has been filed seeking the grant of interim bail to the Petitioner.

12. Learned senior counsel for the Petitioner has submitted the following reasons for the grant of interim protection to the Petitioner herein:
a.

The Petitioner was granted bail vide Order dated 27.03.2025 by the learned ASJ,
which continued till 30.05.2025 and throughout this period, the Petitioner never misused the liberty granted to him.
b. All the witnesses being employees of Uflex, the Petitioner cannot exercise any influence over them.
Moreover, there is no allegation or indication, either from the IO or the Complainant, of any attempt by the Petitioner to tamper with evidence or influence any witness.
c. There are seven signatories to Uflex's bank account and out of the 400 invoices for payments only a few of them have been signed by Petitioner's father, Mr. Anup Sachdeva.
The IO has not investigated who has signed the rest of the invoices for payment.
d. The Petitioner does not pose a flight risk.
He has duly cooperated with the authorities by joining the preliminary inquiry and investigation in July 2024.
Following the registration of the FIR on 25.02.2025, the Petitioner has responded to notices on two subsequent occasions, on This is a digitally signed order.

e. The Petitioner's father is suffering from Stage-III Prostate Cancer, he has an elderly mother and two very young children under the age of 5 years to take care of.
